newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Armor Holdings Q2 oper shr $0.08.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Armor Holdings Q2 oper shr $0.08.

text.p: Six months ended Three months ended

On April 16, 1997, Armor Holdings acquired DSL Group, Ltd in a transaction accounted for as a "Pooling of Interests." Accordingly, results of operations for the three and six month periods ended June 28, 1997 have been restated to reflect the combined results of the Company and DSL. Fees and expenses associated with completing the transaction (approximately $1,000,000) have been expensed rather than capitalized as in a typical purchase of assets. These expenses in combination with certain other charges relating to the financial and administrative restructuring and consolidation of DSL Group, Ltd into the Company totaled $2,542,000, or $0.13 per share, and represent a one- time charge. The charge represents approximately 10% of the purchase price of DSL Group, Ltd.
